scripts.dev: npm run build -w @guaita/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @guaita/server" "npm run dev -w @guaita/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @guaita/shared && npm run build -w @guaita/server && npm run build -w @guaita/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @guaita/shared && npm run build -w @guaita/shared && npm run typecheck -w @guaita/server && npm run typecheck -w @guaita/web
